fieldValues.title: CrossFieldRule property present for wrong rule type MUST be reported as a Type-level error
fieldValues.normative_statement: A `CrossFieldRule` that contains a property belonging to a different rule type MUST be reported as a Type-level validation error. Specifically: a `conditional-required` or `field-ordering` rule MUST NOT supply `fieldIds`; a `mutual-exclusion` rule MUST NOT supply `predicateFieldId`, `predicateValue`, `targetFieldId`, or `effect`. (RFC-019 R10.)
